This leaf is found chiefly in cold climates, especially in short-grass plains, and is best known in northern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

Very fresh Tuxlaxar leaves are brewed into an infusion. This powerful styptic can stop any bleeding within 1–10 rounds. The freshness of the leaves therefore matters directly to preparation. Repeated administrations also carry a risk of habituation.
